summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a skiing holiday. Since Kogoro has lost the key to their ski lodge, they accept Professor Masashi Oyama's invitation to his lodge. At dinner, they meet his assistants, who are celebrating the success of his latest publication. After dinner, everyone goes their separate ways. Kaori Nakahara, who forgot something while shopping, goes back to get groceries for the others, Professor Oyama watches his favorite TV show, Ginji Tobita goes night skiing, and Tomoyasu Kanazawa takes a bath. While Kogoro sleeps off his hangover, Conan and Ran help Kaho Ezumi with the dishes.

victims.name: Masashi Oyama
victims.causeOfDeath: Multiple stab wounds to the back

suspects: Kaori Nakahara, Tomoyasu Kanazawa, Ginji Tobita, and Kaho Ezumi
